status: provisional — NOT frozen until cross-machine reproduction passes
fixed_quantum_v1_rule: Every NONTERMINAL transition advances exactly one full control quantum.
A valid environment terminal MAY end the final transition early; the remaining quantum is not padded.
No transitions occur after a terminal state.
Search comparability is therefore defined over nonterminal transitions.
discounting_change_policy: introducing discounting creates a new leaf/search version (GUARDRAILS-v2 6.1)
replan_boundary_rule: rootStance is immutable for the lifetime of one search.
A predicted stance crossing marks the node requiresReplan and stops expansion.
The node is valued with the current search's unchanged leaf and objective.
No next-stance actions are exposed. No transition bonus is applied.
stance_model_disposition: Boundary statistics under this scaffold are mechanism-conformance data only. They are never used for promotion or tuning, and the threshold is never adjusted to produce a desired statistic.
development_defaults_note: Development values. NOT frozen production values; the final quantum and horizon are selected in W0-A'/W1B.
